what: A work order whose executing office is left as 'the same Office' is treated as Ahmedabad's: Ahmedabad's Coordinator and Branch Manager list, open and EDIT Mumbai's local work orders (edit saved). Cause: call_office_clause / scope_allows map a blank office to the Ahmedabad (head) office (lib/access.php:1729, 1762; lib/ops.php:730).
rule: docs/02 Calls — Edit own branch; branch batch B1/B3

what: For Mumbai's own local work order the allocation form pre-selects Ahmedabad as executing office and demands an inter-office credit; a job saved with a blank office is then outside Mumbai's own scope.
rule: docs/02 Jobs — allocate own branch; §a.viii credit only when offices differ

what: An expense line is deleted by simply opening a link (GET, no form token, no confirmation) and by a coordinator of another branch (lib/ops.php:8891).
rule: Branch rule; money records; CSRF protection on changes

what: Deputation actions check the role only (pdso_can_edit, lib/pdso.php:842): Mumbai's Coordinator set an Ahmedabad deputation to Cancelled and added a timesheet row; the 'outside your scope' message only appears after saving.
rule: Branch batch B2 pattern (check branch before saving)

what: An Approved client attendance period can be set back to Draft while its 3-man-day billable event stays Pending (billable without approval). Reversed (30 Nov→18 Nov) and duplicate periods are accepted.
rule: Billing must follow the client-approved period; B list 025

what: A job saved with Man-days 0 ('counts them from the dates') adds 0 to the contract's used quantity (quote_qty_used sums jobs.mandays, lib/contracts.php:315): 15 booked man-days showed as '10 of 10'.
rule: Contract exhausted rule (man-days used vs bought)

what: The contract gate checks only the quantity already used, not the job being allocated: with 1 of 10 man-days left a 5-man-day job was allocated (14 of 10). No 'running low' warning at 10% left (lib/contracts.php:597).

Contract exceptions queue and Endorse/Refuse are not branch-limited: Mumbai's Branch Manager endorsed an Ahmedabad exception; the Branch Application Manager is offered Endorse; Mumbai Coordinator and Finance see Ahmedabad requests (lib/contracts.php:686, 1400).
rule: Branch rule; flow text 'the Branch Manager endorses'

what: Final approval of a contract opening is not branch-limited: Mumbai's Branch Manager opened an Ahmedabad contract; the waiting list names other branches' managers (contract_sig_user_holds checks role only).
Deleting a work order checks only the role (ops.call.delete), not the branch: Ahmedabad's Branch Application Manager deleted a Mumbai work order (lib/ops.php:5536).
rule: docs/02 Calls — BAM View·D own branch

what: Another branch's Branch Manager reopened a locked Ahmedabad job (saved, then 'outside scope'). Lock texts show raw dates (2026-11-18).
HR reconciliation reads every branch's vouchers: an Ahmedabad coordinator sees Mumbai staff's present/leave days (lib/ops.php:9638).
rule: Branch rule; vouchers own + chain (plan 29 A)

what: Any coordinator can set another branch's inspector on leave/available (no office check on save, lib/workforce.php:638).
Recurring schedules are not branch-scoped: Ahmedabad created a Mumbai schedule and 'Generate due now' generated Mumbai's due work order. Spaces-only title still says 'created' (DEF-OPS-016).
Monthly schedule from 31 Oct jumps to 1 Dec (November skipped) — PHP '+1 month' overflow (lib/tosrm.php:1696). Generated work orders still have no number/contracting office (DEF-OPS-015).
rule: Recurring service must produce one work order per month

what: Every late report counts as on time: the rating uses the job's actual turnaround (tat_days) as the allowed time (lib/rating.php:62); an 18-days-late inspector scores 73, same as an on-time one.
Quotation picker endpoints return another branch's client quotes, totals and line rates by address (no office filter, lib/ops.php:4711, 4728, 961).
Reassign works on a closed job with no reason; Reschedule accepts a non-existent date (29 Feb 2026) and leaves the visit dates unchanged; no double-booking warning (DEF-OPS-028).
rule: Job lifecycle; A10 warn when booked

what: A work order closed through its status can still be allocated and the assignment e-mail goes out (DEF-OPS-019, A4 still open).
Deleting a work order leaves its billable event (₹8,000), reports and expenses (DEF-OPS-010, owner choice A12 pending).

When Finance is the claimant, the 'waits for' text names Test Finance ('Office Finance (Test Finance)') though the claimant can never approve; it really waits for an administrator and no warning is shown (vappr_waiting_text does not drop barred people, lib/voucher_approval.php:526).
rule: Plan 29: 'waits for an admin with a clear warning'

what: 'Save all rows & totals' keeps three decimals (total ₹12,833.333; CSV balance 5833.333) and the message rounds to ₹12,833 — not rounded to paise (lib/ops.php:8307).
An already granted exception can be Refused afterwards, overwriting who granted it (no status check, lib/contracts.php:1389).
If the browser does not fill 'Total credit', the server refuses even though it recalculates rate × quantity itself afterwards (check at lib/ops.php:5843 runs before 5905).
Timesheet hours −4 and 30 accepted (DEF-OPS-024, B list).
A shift crossing midnight India time cannot be closed: OUT at 00:10 says 'Mark IN first' (DEF-OPS-041, B list).
Empty work order saved with a number; required date before received date accepted (DEF-OPS-006, 009).
No 'someone else saved' warning on the first edit from two tabs (DEF-OPS-007).
